author: TexLite contributors
description: IO traffic inside an Amazon Aurora storage node, redrawn after Figure 4 of Verbitski et al., SIGMOD 2017: eight numbered steps from receiving log records and acknowledging them, through sorting, peer gossip and coalescing into data pages, to S3 backup, garbage collection and scrubbing.

invariants: positions are in layout units traced from the original figure; move boxes and wires together so that wires still meet their boxes
only steps 1 and 2 are on the foreground path in the original; keep the numbering if the labels keep their meaning
keep the source note at the top of the file

operations.summary: edit the label macros at the top
rename the stores and activities and keep the numbered-step layout for a different storage engine
add n/x/y to the \foreach list of stepmark nodes
call \store{name}{centre x}{top y}{bottom y} and place its label and record squares on top

parameters.meaning: size of one layout unit; scales the geometry while the type size stays fixed
parameters.name: \gridunit

name: Aurora storage node IO (Verbitski et al.)

source.paper: Amazon Aurora: Design Considerations for High Throughput Cloud-Native Relational Databases
